name: legal-it-8b
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from mistralai/Ministral-3-8B-Instruct-2512 (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-27. A finetune of mistralai/Ministral-3-8B-Instruct-2512, not a new base model: same config.json, same 8.92 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-10-04. Distribution caveat: the repo ships only legal-it-8b-Q4_K_M.gguf, no bf16 weights. The card's comparisons are for the SFT+GRPO fine-tune proper and it separately shows quantisation cost nothing (435 vs 437 of 472 on a dev exam, p=0.77), so the card numbers are the fine-tune's, not the Q4's.

benchmarks.name: Italian legal held-out exam (429 q)
benchmarks.config: Card table 'Modello | Corrette, su 429': 382/429 = 89.0% vs Ministral-3-8B-Instruct-2512 base 347/429 = 80.9%, same retrieval, McNemar p<0.05. Graded by Qwen3-30B-A3B judge. Repo distributes Q4_K_M GGUF only; card separately shows Q4 costs nothing (435 vs 437 on a 472-q dev exam).
